test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1326d3360ead8d5d920dfbd6dbd0fd98d1d2f64549450b5eaeda863147cdba3b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) For star element → The number of star element decreases subsequently.

2) For plus sign element → The number of plus sign element increases subsequently.

3) For arrow element → The arrow element flipped horizontally subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dd21bb6e7b1fd007a607a6d0432d76d55b5788a5eef873ff5654226ed5f37f3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/475a2adf6de88b4a060083d2086299ac753dbd2a140bd7aa698e9ae01d5d0f2e.png] 

Thus, the final series is: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f9a084a12e8aa7a9c99af4438e05f364f1f54434b9e55f1249ad7a0463210fa.png] 

 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
